claims.disproof_condition: 條件：MACOM 的 10-K／10-Q、法說或產品頁寫出 MARP-BP112 等 200G/lane 光偵測器停產或退出。核查頻率：每年（10-K）。觸發後 48 小時：改寫光偵測器層讀圖的供給側。
claims.statement: Supply side (MACOM press release 2025-03-25): MACOM announced availability of four 200G-per-lane solutions for 1.6T data center optical connectivity, including the MARP-BP112 backside-illuminated photodiode with integrated lens that can be chip-stacked on MACOM's TIAs. Product availability announcement; no volume or customer named.

source_doc.permission_basis: 發行人官網新聞稿（公開）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取新聞稿日期 2025-03-25。
source_doc.title: MACOM 新聞稿 2025-03-25〈MACOM Launches New High Performance Solutions for 1.6T Applications〉：200G/lane 的 CW 雷射與 MARP-BP112 光偵測器（可疊在 MACOM 的 TIA 上）

sources.quote: MACOM Technology Solutions Inc. (“MACOM”) , a leading supplier of semiconductor products, today announced the availability of four new 200G per lane solutions for 1.6T data center optical connectivity.

sources.locator: Photodiode (PD) and TIA Chip Stack Solution
sources.quote: The MARP-BP112 backside illuminated PD with integrated lens enables chip stacking of photodiodes on MACOM’s transimpedance amplifiers (TIAs), which optimizes total system performance and helps to reduce assembly costs.

sources.locator: Photodiode (PD) and TIA Chip Stack Solution
sources.quote: Designed utilizing MACOM’s proprietary optical semiconductor process, the MARP-BP112 PD features high responsivity and high bandwidth, which are critical for achieving the required bit error rate (BER) for link performance.
